Each submission hangs on the fable of a task receipt, and the harbor is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The ocean of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on receipt hashes checked against public logs before trust.
